tracesTo: SOW: Commissioner Desk & Weekly Content Publishing
UserFlow: Weekly Commissioner Desk → Optional Content Creation & Publishing to Feed

stories.title: Automatically Advance to Next Week After Publishing
stories.goal: automatically move to the next week's Commissioner Desk after successfully publishing current week's content
stories.benefit: I can immediately start working on next week's content without manual navigation or week selection
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically advances Commissioner Desk to next week (current week + 1) immediately after successful publish operation completes
Week selector updates to show new week as 'Active' with draft status for all content sections
System displays success modal confirming publish with 'Continue to Next Week' button and 'View Published Content' alternative
If user selects 'Continue to Next Week', system navigates to empty Commissioner Desk for next week with week number updated in header
Previously published week shows 'Published' badge in week selector with green checkmark indicator
System handles season boundary gracefully: displays 'Season Complete' message when advancing past final playoff week
Auto-advance respects NFL week schedule: warns if advancing to week that hasn't started yet with countdown timer to week start
System preserves unsaved draft content for current week in case user needs to republish or make updates
Week transition creates audit log entry with timestamp, commissioner user, and published week number
User preference setting allows disabling auto-advance to stay on published week for review

stories.title: Copy Previous Week's Content as Template for New Week
stories.goal: quickly start new week's content by copying relevant parts from previous week as a starting template
stories.benefit: I save time by reusing formatting, team order patterns, and commentary structure from previous weeks
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Copy from Previous Week' button at top of Commissioner Desk when starting new week
Copy operation allows selective copying: Power Rankings only, Matchup Hype Template only, Predictions Pattern only, or All Content
When copying power rankings, system preserves team order and commentary structure but marks commentary as '[Update needed]' placeholder
Copied rankings automatically adjust to current week's standings with visual diff showing moved teams since last week
System preserves matchup hype text template but updates team names and matchup context for current week's matchups
Prediction copying transfers confidence patterns and commentary style but requires new winner selection
Copy operation is non-destructive: creates new draft without affecting published content from previous week
System displays modal showing preview of copied content before confirming copy action
Copied content includes 'Copied from Week [X]' annotation for tracking content lineage
User can undo copy operation and start with blank template if copied content isn't useful
System tracks copy template usage metrics: frequency of copying, which sections most copied, time saved estimates

stories.title: Track Week Status and Publishing History Across Season
stories.goal: view complete season overview showing which weeks are published, draft, or skipped with quick navigation
stories.benefit: I can quickly understand my season progress and navigate to any week to view or edit content
acceptanceCriteria: System provides season calendar view accessible from Commissioner Desk showing all weeks in grid layout
Each week displays status badge: Published (green), Draft (yellow), Skipped (gray), Upcoming (blue), or Not Started (white)
Published weeks show publication date, commissioner who published, and quick preview of content with thumbnail
Calendar view displays mini-statistics for each week: rankings published (Y/N), matchup featured (Y/N), predictions count
User can click any week to navigate directly to that week's Commissioner Desk for viewing or editing
Season progress bar shows percentage of weeks completed with target completion rate based on current NFL week
System highlights current NFL week in calendar with 'Current Week' indicator to maintain context
Calendar includes search/filter: show only published weeks, show only weeks with specific content types, show weeks needing updates
Season view displays commissioner activity metrics: total weeks published, average time to publish, consistency score
System sends reminder notifications for upcoming weeks: 'Week [X] starts in 3 days - time to start your rankings!'
Export functionality allows downloading season publishing history as CSV for external analysis or record-keeping

stories.title: Handle Week Status Transitions with Validation
stories.goal: change week status (Draft → Published → Skipped) with appropriate validations and warnings
stories.benefit: I can manage my publishing workflow flexibly while preventing invalid state transitions
acceptanceCriteria: System allows marking week as 'Skipped' from draft state when commissioner doesn't want to publish that week
Skipping week displays confirmation modal explaining impact: no feed moments, no rankings update, no predictions tracked
System prevents skipping weeks that are already published without first unpublishing with warning message
Unpublish action removes feed moments, reverts rankings page to previous week, and deletes predictions from database
System warns before unpublishing if week has graded predictions or if stat corrections have occurred
Week can be moved from Skipped back to Draft status to resume content creation
System validates week order: warns if publishing week out of sequence (publishing week 5 before week 4)
Status transitions create audit trail entries: who changed status, when, from what status to what status
Bulk status operations allowed for multiple weeks: 'Mark weeks 15-17 as Skipped' for leagues with shortened seasons
System displays pending transitions: 'Publishing in progress', 'Unpublishing in progress' with progress indicators
Status change notifications sent to other league commissioners (if multiple commissioners exist) for coordination

stories.title: Manage Commissioner Workflow Across Multiple Devices
stories.goal: seamlessly continue working on weekly content across desktop and mobile devices
stories.benefit: I can start content on desktop and finish on mobile without losing progress or context
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically saves draft content to database every 30 seconds or on input blur
Draft content syncs across devices in real-time using Supabase Realtime subscriptions
Mobile app displays 'Draft Updated on Another Device' notification when cross-device changes detected
User can review changes and choose to keep current device version or accept synced version in conflict scenarios
System preserves cursor position and scroll location when switching devices (within reasonable timeframe)
Commissioner Desk mobile interface adapts layout for smaller screens while maintaining all functionality
Drag-and-drop team ranking is replaced with up/down arrow buttons on mobile for accessibility
Mobile publish button includes same validation and atomic transaction behavior as desktop
System tracks device usage patterns: desktop vs mobile creation time, publish device preference, cross-device frequency
Offline mode allows continuing draft edits on mobile without connection with sync on reconnection
System displays sync status indicator: 'All changes saved', 'Saving...', 'Offline - changes will sync when connected'
